legacyTitle: Kamadhoo Island | Baa Atoll, Maldives - Authentic Island Experience

faqs.question: How do I get to Kamadhoo Island?
faqs.answer: The most convenient way to reach Kamadhoo is by domestic flight from Male to Dharavandhoo Airport (30 minutes), followed by a 40-minute speedboat transfer. Public ferry service operates weekly from Male (approximately 12 hours journey time).

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Kamadhoo Island?
faqs.answer: The best time to visit Kamadhoo Island is during the northeast monsoon season (December to April), which brings dry, sunny weather with lower humidity and calmer seas.
